newsitem.title: USA: Standex says plans to buy Acme Manufacturing.
newsitem.headline: Standex says plans to buy Acme Manufacturing.

text.p: Standex International Corp said Wednesday it agreed in principle to buy the net assets of privately-held Acme Manufacturing Co of Philadelphia for an undisclosed amount of cash.
Standex said it expects the acquisition will be accretive to earnings immediately. The deal is scheduled to close Sept. 30.
Acme Manufacturing makes heating ventilation and air conditioning material for the home building industry.
Standex said its Standex Air Distribution group makes and sells a similar product line.
The company said the deal provides it with an entry into "new geographic areas" of the United States.
The company said the deal will make it a company with a nationwide manufacturing and distribution network.
